description: Which `process.env.NAME` reads may reach a browser bundle. The Rust bundler (`boundary::env_read_is_private`, also used by `ruvyxa_graph`) and the Node compiler (`envReadIsPrivate` in `runtime/compiler.mjs`) each decide this independently, so both replay this table. AGENTS.md already listed this policy as fixture-held; it was not, and the rule had drifted once before.
rule: A read is private unless the name is exactly NODE_ENV or begins with RUVYXA_PUBLIC_.

cases.name: NODE_ENV
cases.why: substituted at build time; the most ordinary line in a React app

cases.name: RUVYXA_PUBLIC_
cases.why: bare prefix still carries the opt-in

cases.name: NODE_ENVIRONMENT
cases.why: NODE_ENV is exempt by exact match, not by prefix

cases.name: MY_NODE_ENV
cases.why: exemption is not a substring match

cases.name: RUVYXA_PUBLIC
cases.why: missing the trailing underscore is not the public prefix

cases.name: PREFIX_RUVYXA_PUBLIC_X
cases.why: the prefix must start the name

cases.name: RUVYXA_SECRET
cases.why: a framework-looking name is not automatically public
an empty name is not an exemption
